translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Asaa Bolla Pirddennaan Aggussaa
Ammanuwaan azalliyaa uraa shiishshi akkite. Shin I bare huup'ew k'oppiyaabaan aanana palumettoppite.
Itti uraa ammanuu I ayaa miinanne diggenna. Shin ammanuwaan azalliyaa uray gaden mokkeeddabaa s'alalaa mee.
Ubbabaa miyaa uray ubbabaa meenna uraa kad'oppo; ubbabaa meenna uraykka ubbabaa miyaa uraa bolla pirddoppo. Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay Aa shiishshi akkeedda.
Hara asaa k'oomaa bolla pirddiyaawe neeni oonee? I kunddina woy denddina bare Godaassa; shin Goday Aa dentsanaw danddayiyaa diraw, I ek'k'ana.

Itti uray, «Hik'k'a gallassay hara gallassatuwaappe aad'd'ee» yaagiide k'oppiyaa wode, haray, «Ubbaa gallassatuukka itti mala» giide k'oppee. Asay ubbay huup'iyaan huup'iyaan hewaadan ayaw k'oppintto akeeko.

Itti gallassaa hara gallassatuwaappe aatsiide bonchchiyaa uray Godaa bonchchoo bonchchee; k'umaa miyaa uraykka Godaa bonchchoo mee. Ayaw gooppe, I he k'umaa diraw, S'oossaa galatee. K'umaa meennawekka Godaa bonchchoo meennaan aggeedda; k'ay S'oossaa galatee.
Ayaw gooppe, nuuppe ooninne bare huup'e s'alalaw de'enna; k'ay ooninne bare huup'e s'alalaw hayk'k'enna.
Nuuni pas'a de'ooppe, Godaw de'eetto; k'ay hayk'k'ooppekka, Godaw hayk'k'eetto. Simmi nuuni pas'a de'ooppe woy hayk'k'ooppekka Godaassa.
Hewaa diraw, Kiristtoosi pas'a de'iyaawanttoonne hayk'k'eeddawanttoo Godaa gidanaw hayk'k'iide, hayk'uwaappe denddeedda.
Yaatina, neeni ne ishaa bolla ayaw pirdday? Woy neeni ne ishaa ayaw kad'ay? Nuuni ubbaykka S'oossaa pirddaa oydiyaa sintsan ek'k'ana.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa Mas'aafay,
yaagee.
Simmi nuuni huup'iyaan huup'iyaan nubaa S'oossaw odana.
Nagaraa Oosoo Gaasuwaa Gidoppa
Hewaa diraw, nuuni ittuu ittuwaa bolla pirddiyaawaa hawaappe sintsaw ane aggoytte. Shin ubbaappe aatsiide, hintte ishaa d'ubbiyaabaa woy nagaraan oliyaabaa ootsennaadan k'ofaa k'achchite.
Taani Godaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosanna de'iyaawaan, bare huup'ew tuna gidiyaabay baynnawaa eraynne akeekay. Shin itti uray ittibaa tuna giide k'oppooppe, hewe aw tuna gidee.
Neeni miyaabaa diraw, ne ishaa k'ohooppe, simmi neeni siik'uwaan de'akka. Kiristtoosi Aa diraw hayk'k'eedda asaa ne miyaa k'umaan bayizzoppa.
Simmi neeni lo"obaa giyaawaa Asay kad'oppo.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa kawutetsay Geeshsha Ayyaanay immiyaa s'illotetsaa, sarotetsaanne nashechchaa gidiyaawaappe attin, muussaanne ushshaa gidenna.
Ayaw gooppe, Kiristtoosaw hawaadan ootsiyaa uray ooninne S'oossaa nashechchee; asaykka Aa galatee.
Yaatooppe, ane nuuni sarotetsaa ahiyaabaanne nuuna ittuwaa ittuwaanna minisiyaabaa ubbaa koyyeetto.
S'oossaa oosuwaa k'umaa diraw bayizzoppa. K'umay ubbay geeshsha; shin hara uraa nagaraan yeggiyaawaa muussay iita.
Hewoo ashuwaa meennaan woy ushshaa ushennaan aggiyaawe woy ne ishaa d'ubbiyaabaa ayaanne ootsennaan aggiyaawe lo"a.

Ha yewuwaan ne ammanuwaa neeppenne S'oossaappe gidduwaan naaga. Itti uray lo"a giide I ammanetteedawaa ootsiyaa wode, «Taani lo"uwaa ootsaad» giide bare wozanaan ammanettooppe, he uray tumu anjjetteeddawaa.
Shin I he miyaabaan sid'ooppe, Aa muussay ammanuwaana gidenna diraw, S'oossay Aa bolla pirddee; k'ay ammanuu baynnaan ootseeddawe ayayneekka nagaraa.
